inputs.text: [excited] SEN… troh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "kentron" means point, sharp spike. And "saurus" is lizard.
[happily] Exactly. His whole frill was lined with little spikes. [warmly] He lived in Canada, seventy-five million years ago.
[nervous] Did he have a hunter chasing him around?
[serious] Yes, Gorgosaurus, a cousin of T. rex.
